description: The data provision service of the Nature Conservation Agency of the Czech Republic lists the agency's spatial datasets, each marked as open data or available after registration or on request, with its update date. Open datasets include small and large specially protected areas with their protection zones, contractually protected areas, memorial trees (updated 10 September 2026), Natura 2000 sites, biosphere reserves, the consolidated ecosystem layer for 2013 and 2021, geoparks, the territorial system of ecological stability (ÚSES), sites of specially protected species, habitats of large mammals (wolf, lynx, bear, moose), biogeographic regions, the database of migration barriers and small hydropower plants on important rivers, speleological objects and the priority migration rivers under the river network permeability concept (updated 17 September 2026). Habitat mapping (VMB) and species occurrence data need registration. The agency also lists datasets on its ISOP portal and runs an ArcGIS open data hub. Access to the open datasets is free; the other sets need registration or a request, and no licence is named on the page read. Caveats: the site is in Czech and update dates vary widely by dataset. Coverage is the Czech Republic. It supports climate adaptation and hazard exposure analysis, such as screening roads, rail and energy corridors against protected areas, ecological corridors and river barriers; the related record is the AOPK watercourses and wetlands portal.
